title: Safe Academy 360 certified academies
description: Public directory and verify data. Academy level only. Never include a coach's name, any individual's screening outcome, or any contact person.

certificate.description: Academy certificate number as printed on the placard, e.g. SAI-2026-00001

state.description: Two letter US state or territory code

certified.description: Date the academy was first certified, YYYY-MM-DD

renewalDue.description: Date the current certification lapses if not renewed, YYYY-MM-DD

status.description: current: certification is in effect. lapsed: a renewal date passed and the academy has not yet renewed. Neutral, never punitive.

fixture.description: true marks a fictional row used only in development. The build drops fixture rows unless run with --fixtures.
